The '''CR25 troop carrier''', more commonly known as the '''Republic dropship''', was a multipurpose [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] used to deploy units of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] in battlefronts where the use of an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] was deemed too impractical.

==Characteristics==
The [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] and [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]] favored the CR25 over the [[CR20 troop carrier/Legends|CR-20]], because it had more cargo space, could hold eight [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunships and had ports for null [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] space debarking.

==History==
===New Sith Wars===
[[Odionate]] forces used transports visually similar to the CR25. They were used to carry [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] into battle that were visually similar to the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]].<ref name="KEE1">[[Knight Errant: Escape 1|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 1]]</ref>

===Clone Wars===
The CR25 was known as the "bigger brother" of the [[CR20 troop carrier/Legends|CR-20 troop carrier]]. [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] traveled in a CR25 and used its debarking ports to board the captured assault ship ''[[Prosecutor]]''.
